Slider left→right = disassembly. Right→left = the same steps in reverse: the assembly procedure. Each band of the slider moves exactly one step. Drag the canvas to orbit, wheel to zoom.
Rendered from the same parametric CAD that generated the STEP files (Gear/generate_drivetrain.py, Gear/mold_tyre.py). 19T→40T, 2.105:1, M0.5 20°; F683ZZ bearings on live D3 axles; N20 encoder motors; PCB is the imported fab model. Mould scene: pour-through-the-wheel v2, fill path verified.
